assertions: Complete current published navigation forbids the direct app import of native expedition compilers.
Both distinct Hunt owners and both expedition owners remain visible and enabled in ordinary Missions, without remote gameplay materialization or installation.
Incoming exact Solo Ready and reopened page finish with the chosen native mission, tick0, paused, briefing overlay, closed chooser and unchanged saved state.
An older snapshot removes only the optional supplemental field and repins its exact generated bytes; its real native compilation fallback and ordinary rows remain available.
Existing starter/optional online chapter, saved-flight/offline retention, timed-out retention and ordinary mode departure regressions remain passing.

checks.independentReadOnlyReview: Snake agent reported no blocker before test execution.

correctionToEarlierReadOnlyProposal: Hunt tags use the selected difficulty in the native helper, as Team tags do; only Duel Expeditions use standard tags. The earlier static audit proposal stating that Hunt tags were standard was incorrect. SIM production parity tests and implementation preserve the actual selected-difficulty rule.
limits: Node browser-boundary host tests use actual app/providers/native validators and controlled browser/storage boundaries; no WebKit timing or pixel/render equivalence claim.
Import guard observes the direct app multiplayer-expeditions branch, not every possible transitive module import.
The older fixture derives the retained optional-field-absent format from current generated mission metadata; it is not a byte-for-byte historical release archive.
The prior WebKit strict native blob error and original timeout receipts remain failed and unchanged; fresh emitted browser qualification is still required.
